_doku: P1 (Codex review of #91, 04.11.2026): issuers whose shown market cap is the sum over their listed share classes, each class at its own close.

Read by lib/mcap-class-sum.js in the merge job (scripts/apply-mcap-class-sum.js, after the price merge): value = sum of shares x close of the newest trading day on which every class has a close in prices/history, x USD per unit from fx-rates.json of the same run. The value goes into every class line the pull did not hold; held lines keep their hold.
No common close within 10 days, a class without closes, or no FX rate: the value is empty with a German reason, never a guess.

shares: issuer count of each class without treasury shares, from the source quote. reviewBy: after it the pull log warns every run and the sum is still computed; re-verify the counts and move reviewBy.

The 16 share-count rows that froze the price ratio of 30.10.2026 into H or A equivalents are removed with this file (their counts and sources are copied below); the shadow registry configs/mcap-classes-registry.json is unchanged.
